name: Component Dynamics
old_description: Electronic Resellers Association International (ERAI) was founded in 1995 and serves to provide members with resources for risk mitigation for vendors, and specific products in the global electronic supply chain.
about:
Component Dynamics operates from Portsmouth, New Hampshire, as an independent supplier of electronic components. The company specializes in sourcing obsolete, last-time-buy, and hard-to-find parts through a global network of qualified sources.

The firm provides component sourcing, excess inventory management, obsolescence mitigation, cost-savings programs, and warehousing and fulfillment services. Its inventory is held across three accredited hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia, each certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ANSI/ESD S2020 standards. A multi-stage inspection process and an in-house vendor rating program support its quality system.

Customers include aerospace and defense contractors, original equipment manufacturers, and government agencies that require traceable, counterfeit-free components. The company's AS9120B and AS6081 certifications reflect its focus on the aviation and defense supply chains, while its participation in the Government Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) further aligns it with public-sector procurement.

Component Dynamics emphasizes its independence and flexibility, allowing it to negotiate across franchised and non-franchised channels. Its integrated management system targets high customer satisfaction, on-time delivery, and low return rates, with reported metrics of 96 percent satisfaction, 95 percent on-time delivery, and a sub-1 percent RMA rate.
